screenshots.caption: Create a portable GMW archive with Fast, Balanced, Smallest, or Queryable Vault profiles and optional authenticated encryption.
Protect one file, or batch a folder into independent encrypted Sealed Files, each with its own separately stored recovery key.
Keep compressed snapshots, search file history, verify stored data, and restore an earlier folder state.
Search filenames and supported text inside a local Queryable Vault without unpacking the full collection.
Browse structured files as local tables or run read-only SQL and export only the results you need.
